lead.event: MNC Sky Vision faces temporary PKPU and prepares debt restructuring
lead.headline: MSKY faces 43-day temporary PKPU as it prepares debt restructuring
lead.blurb: MNC Sky Vision was placed in temporary PKPU on 5 November for 43 calendar days, while 9M2026 revenue fell to Rp166.83 billion from Rp302.1 billion a year earlier. The Central Jakarta Commercial Court granted Ascot Group Holdings Ltd's petition over a USD4 million claim, recorded as Rp71.99 billion in trade payables at 30 September. The company is negotiating a debt restructuring and peace plan, with management saying obligations would be paid in stages from operating results and met through operating cash flow. The PKPU period runs until 17 December.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: MSKY's 9M2026 revenue fell to Rp166.83 billion from Rp302.1 billion a year earlier.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Merdeka Battery Materials plans a 10.79-billion-share private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MBMA plans private placement of up to 10.8 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Merdeka Battery Materials would price shares at no less than 90% of the 25-day average closing price. The issue equals 10% of paid-up capital and could dilute holders by up to 9.09%, with about a quarter of proceeds for working capital and the rest for expansion. Shareholders vote on 8 December, subject to independent approval.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: MEDC offers USD300 million notes to refinance existing debt
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MEDC offers USD300 million notes to refinance existing debt
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Medco Energy is offering the notes at 8.875%, maturing in 2032, through its indirect subsidiary Medco Redwood Tree Limited. Proceeds will be used to refinance or repay existing debt, including notes due 2028, and replace an undrawn committed facility.

deals_control.event: TGRA proposes a 21 billion-share private placement
deals_control.headline: TGRA proposes 21 billion-share placement, with AMS to take control via 15 billion shares
deals_control.blurb: Terregra Asia Energy plans to issue the shares at Rp10 each for up to Rp210 billion. Adidaya Mandiri Sejahtera will subscribe for 15 billion shares and become the new controlling shareholder after completion, subject to shareholder approval at an extraordinary meeting on 28 December.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: AMS will execute 15 billion shares and become TGRA's new controlling shareholder after completion.

earnings_guidance.event: CGS International cuts GoTo's target price and raises its 2026 profit forecast
earnings_guidance.headline: CGS International raises GOTO's 2026 profit forecast to Rp1.4 trillion, cuts target to Rp35
earnings_guidance.blurb: Joanne Ong raised the projection by 180% and lifted her Adjusted EBITDA estimate by 7% to Rp3.5 trillion, while maintaining an Add recommendation for GoTo. The lower sum-of-the-parts valuation reflects a higher Indonesian risk premium after an MSCI warning, lifting the cost-of-equity assumption to 13.3% from 10.9%.

earnings_guidance.event: XLSMART reports nine-month 2026 results and raises its synergy target
earnings_guidance.headline: EXCL reports nine-month results and raises 2026 gross synergy target above US$300 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: XLSMART's revenue grew about 17% year on year in the nine months to 30 September, while normalized EBITDA rose 12% to Rp16.42 trillion and normalized net profit climbed 94% to Rp3.59 trillion. Cumulative gross synergy realization reached US$294 million, with 96% of planned network locations integrated.

earnings_guidance.event: Indika Energy targets 50% non-coal revenue by 2028 as Awak Mas advances
earnings_guidance.headline: INDY targets 50% non-coal revenue by 2028 as Awak Mas reaches 72.84% complete
earnings_guidance.blurb: Indika's non-coal revenue rose 51.3% year on year to September 2026, lifting its share of gross revenue to 23.1% from 19.2%. Awak Mas was 72.84% complete after US$398 million of its estimated US$568 million cost had been spent. The project targets first commercial production in the first half of 2027 at around 100,000 ounces a year.

earnings_guidance.event: ACES raises its 2026 target for new Azko store openings
earnings_guidance.headline: ACES raises 2026 target for new Azko stores to 40-45
earnings_guidance.blurb: Aspirasi Hidup also maintained its plan to open 40-50 Neka stores in 2026. BRI Danareksa analysts see up to 48% potential upside for ACES shares, citing stronger 2026-2027 prospects and expected fourth-quarter sales momentum ahead of Christmas.
